description: A USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION/ERROR statement without the word PROCEDURE — a COBOL-2002 relaxation of a COBOL-85 restriction, QUOTED from ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 141: "USE statement syntax. The word PROCEDURE, previously required, is optional." COBOL-85 is the edition a 2002 Annex F.2 'formerly' statement describes: the owner's decision of 2026-10-31 (kb/Work PB4305) makes the F.2 statements the rule for the 85 edge, as D-SIGN2 (item 124) and PB3683 (item 123) did; GnuCOBOL -std=cobol85 accepts some of them as dialect leniency, which rule 1 places below the ISO text. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitUseStatement, the Format 1 arm (kb/Work PB4305; VCR row 7.47).
display: a USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION/ERROR statement without the word PROCEDURE
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.47 - the 2002 Annex F.2 relaxations of COBOL-85 restrictions (item 141)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMUNP.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 R PIC X(10).

DECLARATIVES.

MAIN SECTION.
